MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_RELIC_HILT.title: Reliquary Hilt
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_ANGELS_BLADE.des:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage and Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_UNSCATHED.title: Without a Scratch
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_UNSCATHED.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Until your next turn, whenever an attack hits you, gain {OnHit} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level, 3 Block per hit from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_STRONG_FLAME.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Bonus} more damage if you have [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_TEN_BLOWS.title: Ten Blows
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_TEN_BLOWS.descri:
This combat, whenever an attack hits you, gain {OnHit} [gold]Block[/gold] (1 more while [gold]Durandal[/gold] is your current sword). At most {MaxTimes} times per turn.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_ROLANDS_BREACH.d:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If this is the first [gold]Blood of Saint Basil[/gold] played this combat, heal {Heal} HP.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level, +1 heal every 2 levels).
Until your next turn, you take at most {Cap} damage at a time.
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (cap 8/8/7/7/6/5).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_HIDDEN_BENEATH.d:
This combat, even while [gold]Durandal[/gold] is not your current sword, attack damage you take is reduced by {Half} per hit (half of Durandal's reduction).
[gold]Durandal[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 1 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ROLANDS_ROCK.title: Roland's Rock
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ROLANDS_ROCK.description:
While this is in your hand, attacks deal {ExtraDamage} more damage to you per hit.
After {Combats} more combats with this in your deck, it removes itself.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_BERSERKER_SOUL.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Wounds} more [gold]Wound[/gold].
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_SHADED_HILT.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If any enemy has [gold]Wounds[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_HROLFS_BLADE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deals additional damage equal to the target's [gold]Wounds[/gold].
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_BARROW_ROBBING.d:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put an Attack card of your choice from your discard pile into your hand.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_BARROW_ROBBING.s: Choose an Attack card to put into your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_KEEP_THE_TABOO.d:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Wounds} [gold]Wound[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_TWELVE_BERSERKER:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Hits} times.
Each hit applies 1 [gold]Wound[/gold] to the enemy it hit.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_OPEN_WOUNDS.desc:
Double the target's [gold]Wounds[/gold] (bursts at once at 12 or more).
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 0 from level 3).
Whenever a [gold]Wound[/gold] bursts, gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] and draw {BurstCards} cards.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (3 cards from level 4).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_TWELVE_SOULS.des:
The target loses {PerWound} HP per [gold]Wound[/gold] (ignores Block), then its Wounds become 0.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (4 per Wound from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_KINGS_GUARD.desc:
At the start of your turn, apply {TurnWounds} [gold]Wound[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Skofnung[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 1 from level 3, 2 Wounds at level 5).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_STONE.title: Skofnung Stone
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_STONE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, every enemy loses {Wounds} [gold]Wounds[/gold]. Enemies without Wounds heal {Heal} HP.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_ONI_SLASH.title: Oni Slash
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_ONI_SLASH.descrip:
[gold]Command[/gold]: [gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately makes 1 auto attack of its current kind ({IaiDamage} damage with Iai).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_GOEI.title: Goei
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_GOEI.description:
Change the auto attack kind to [gold]Goei[/gold].
Guard once right away ({AutoBlock} [gold]Block[/gold]).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_IAI.title: Iai
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_IAI.description:
Change the auto attack kind to [gold]Iai[/gold].
This combat, Iai deals {IaiBonus} more damage (stacks).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+3 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_GIRI.title: Giri
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_GIRI.description:
Change the auto attack kind to [gold]Giri[/gold].
Cut once right away ({AutoDamage} damage to ALL enemies).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_ONI_HUNT.title: Hunting the Oni
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_ONI_HUNT.descript:
[gold]Command[/gold]: [gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately makes 1 auto attack of its current kind.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_RANBU.title: Ranbu
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_RANBU.description:
Change the auto attack kind to [gold]Ranbu[/gold].
Strike once right away ({AutoDamage} damage to random enemies {AutoHits} times).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TAIMA.title: Taima
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TAIMA.description:
Change the auto attack kind to [gold]Taima[/gold].
Exorcise once right away ({AutoDamage} damage and 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TAIHEIKI.title: Record of the Taiheiki
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TAIHEIKI.descript:
[gold]Command[/gold] {Times} times ([gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately auto attacks with its current kind).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
[gold]Command[/gold] {Times} times ([gold]Onimaru[/gold] immediately auto attacks with its current kind).
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_SELF_MOVING_BLADE:
This combat, [gold]Onimaru[/gold] also auto attacks once at the start of your turn.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 1 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MASTERLESS_BLADE.title: Masterless Blade
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MASTERLESS_BLADE.descript: While this is in your hand, [gold]Onimaru[/gold] does not make its end-of-turn auto attack ([gold]Command[/gold] still works).
